Chapter 1000: Chapter 14: Overjoyed (Please Subscribe)

“Under five hundred years old, yet able to condense such a number of Seeds of the Fierce Sun…” Lord Qingfen’s heart was equally filled with shock.

In the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the Seeds of the Fierce Sun were not merely an indicator of one’s depth of understanding of the rules; they held an even deeper significance.

“A gem of this caliber… Qingfen Domain has never seen such a talent, not even the Fierce Sun Ancient Country…”

Lord Qingfen pondered inwardly, uncertain whether such an existence had ever been born in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

The history of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country stretched into unfathomable antiquity, predating Lord Qingfen’s own birth by eons.

“Could it be located there…”

Lord Qingfen turned his gaze in a particular direction—precisely the area where the Yu Family and the Dongyang Clan resided.

“It’s the region where You Jue and Shi Song are walking…” Lord Qingfen’s gaze carried a profound distance.

You Jue, the tall figure, was one of Lord Qingfen’s disciples in the ruling realm, someone held in considerable regard.

“I’ll go there myself.”

Lord Qingfen still felt uneasy and found it necessary to personally verify the matter.

Though the Ancient Fierce Sun Mirror was never wrong, Lord Qingfen merely wanted to confirm it once more.

…

Outside the Yu Family.

Several ancestors of the Dongyang Clan remained stationed in the distance.

“The three Qing Envoys are currently within the Yu Family.” One of the Dongyang Clan elders observed for a while, arriving at the conclusion.

His expertise in the art of causation was profound. Through his earlier interactions with the three Qing Envoys, he was able to vaguely pinpoint the threads of cause and effect.

If the distance were greater, he might only sense a blurry outline, unable to ascertain specific details.

After all, the three Qing Envoys were masters at obscuring cause and effect, making it near impossible to trace them.

Yet with the current proximity, coupled with the fact that two of the Qing Envoys were within the Self-Dao Realm—the same level as the ancestors of the Dongyang Clan—the traces of causation were naturally captured.

“It’s confirmed.”

The leading elder of the Dongyang Clan felt a tightness in his chest.

When the tall figure and the other two Qing Envoys had abruptly departed earlier, he had speculated that it might be related to the Yu Family.

But it was merely speculation.

Not certainty.

Yet now, it was confirmed.

The three Qing Envoys were indeed within the Yu Family.

“Why are the esteemed Qing Envoys at the Yu Family?”

The other ancestors of the Dongyang Clan exchanged whispered conversations, their confusion palpable.

Ignoring the outstanding Dongyang Meng, their top talent, and instead all gathering at the Yu Family?

“Could it be that the Yu Family’s youth is also one of the Ten Fierce Suns?”

The fourth elder of the Dongyang Clan suddenly speculated aloud.

Such a convergence of the three Qing Envoys strongly suggested this possibility.

“Impossible. The power of the Black Pendant I refined cannot recover so easily.”

One elder from the Dongyang Clan furrowed his brow. The Black Pendant’s power was a unique force derived from the path he cultivated.

Even among peers in the Self-Dao Realm, such power posed a significant threat, let alone to Yu Yan, whom he deemed a mere ant far below the eleventh rank.

Even with the life-saving trinkets bestowed by the Yu Family, it would require an enormous amount of time and effort for Yu Yan to survive, let alone to condense the tenth Seed of the Fierce Sun.

“There’s nothing impossible about it. The Black Pendant’s power you refined is far from undefeatable.”

The leading elder of the Dongyang Clan spoke calmly.

At this point, with the behavior of the three Qing Envoys, the most plausible explanation was that the Yu Family’s youth was also one of the Ten Fierce Suns.

The conclusion was clear.

The process? How the Yu Family’s youth managed to survive the Black Pendant’s corruption, recover, and condense the tenth Seed of the Fierce Sun was no longer relevant.

“A pity. We should have acted decisively earlier, cutting off all avenues of escape.”

The elder of the Dongyang Clan who wielded the Black Pendant’s power muttered in a low voice.

Had they known that Yu Yan could condense ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun, they should have outright broken ties with the Yu Family.

“It’s too late for that now.”

The leading elder of the Dongyang Clan replied, “However, our Meng’er is also one of the Ten Fierce Suns. Even if the Yu Family’s youth is the same, our clan is not afraid.”

The leader’s tone carried confidence. After all, with both sides boasting a Ten Fierce Suns genius, neither could overwhelm the other.

“Indeed.”

“That Yu Family youth was merely lucky, condensing ten Fierce Suns by chance. How could he compare to our Meng’er?”

“Pah! The three Qing Envoys are making too much of this. Even if the Yu Family youth has ten Fierce Suns, so what? Our Meng’er has them too.”

The elders of the Dongyang Clan exchanged words, feeling that the Qing Envoys were placing undue importance on the youth of the Yu Family.

“Once they pledge allegiance to Lord Qingfen, the true journey begins…”

The leading elder was about to continue speaking when he suddenly felt an overwhelming surge of heat.

“What’s this?”

The elders of the Dongyang Clan froze, their pupils contracting sharply. Within their field of vision, azure flames began to ignite in all directions, consuming the skies above and the earth below.

The azure flames swayed and roared, boundless and omnipresent.

“Azure Fire Heavens?”

“Is this the arrival of Lord Qingfen?”

“Lord Qingfen?”

“Great Venerable Qingfen?”

The elders of the Dongyang Clan were struck dumb, their hearts trembling.

Where Lord Qingfen went, azure fire swept across the domain, burning all into oblivion with unparalleled ferocity.

Only after being conferred the title of Lord by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country did this ferocity somewhat temper. Yet azure fire still inevitably marked his path.

Were it not for this restraint, in mere moments, the elders of the Dongyang Clan would have been reduced to ashes upon witnessing the azure flames.

“Lord Qingfen has… gone to the Yu Family as well?”

The elders of the Dongyang Clan murmured, their voices quivering, now realizing that something far beyond their comprehension had occurred within the Yu Family.

What could possibly warrant Great Venerable Qingfen’s descent?

“What exactly is Lord Qingfen going to the Yu Family for?”

Every ancestor of the Dongyang Clan found themselves consumed by the same thought.

…

Within the Yu Family.

All around, azure flames blossomed simultaneously, enveloping heaven and earth.

“Great Venerable Qingfen?”

“Lord Qingfen is here?”

The elders of the Yu Family widened their eyes, instantly comprehending the situation.

This was Lord Qingfen! Formerly Great Venerable Qingfen!

Although he was now referred to as Marquis, many still addressed him as ‘Great Venerable Qingfen.’

“Marquis is here.”

The tall figure of You Jue and the other Qing Envoys exchanged glances. While they had anticipated that Yu Yan’s condensation of the Sea of Fierce Sun would attract Lord Qingfen’s attention, they hadn’t expected him to arrive in person.

“Lord Qingfen?”

Lin Yuan’s expression grew serious.

Based on all available information, Lord Qingfen’s strength should be comparable to that of Chaos Venerables within the Chaos Void.

Such a figure was enough to command Lin Yuan’s respect.

Up until now, Lin Yuan had encountered only a handful of Chaos Realm experts, and they were primarily manifesting through imprints or projections.

As for an actual Chaos Venerable? Not one had been seen by him.

The Chaos Dragon Beast within Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent… Lin Yuan had seen this entity’s towering black horn in the distance.

Yet this Chaos Dragon Beast, merely approaching the rank of Chaos Venerable, was actually just a ruler-tier creature at its peak, not a true Chaos Realm being.

Buzz! Buzz! Buzz!

Endless azure flames assembled, forming the figure of a man clad in long azure robes.

The man’s eyes were sharply defined, a cluster of azure flames burning at the center of his brow. He simply stood there, yet the oppressive force he exerted on everyone present was immeasurable.

“Is this a Chaos Venerable?”

Lin Yuan studied him intently.

Chaos Venerables were born of mastery over Chaos Rules, layered spatial-temporal insights, and reaching the Eighth Realm.

A Chaos Venerable, residing within the Chaos Void, was nearly invincible unless deliberately provoking a Chaos Great Saint.

“Chaos Flame?”

Lin Yuan meticulously observed Lord Qingfen.

Cultivation at the Chaos level fundamentally deviated from standard rule cultivation.

Chaos Rules were birthed from the fusion of myriad rules. Once established, they in turn birthed additional rules. For instance, Lord Qingfen had cultivated the path of Chaos Flame.

Using Chaos Rules as his foundation, he derived supreme flame-based rules, creating a Chaos Flame capable of reducing everything—including time and space—to ashes.

…

As Lin Yuan observed Lord Qingfen, Lord Qingfen simultaneously scrutinized Lin Yuan.

“Not only has he condensed over ten thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun, but his physical body is already transforming into the Fierce Sun Divine Body.”

“Unparalleled, truly unparalleled.”

“When I reached this stage, it was after three million years in the Self-Dao Realm.”

Lord Qingfen’s amazement grew with every passing second as he appraised Lin Yuan.

The Fierce Sun Divine Body was a special physique developed after condensing a sufficient number of Seeds of the Fierce Sun—a body that was indisputably the strongest in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

As for the specific number required…

It depended on how synchronously the Seeds of the Fierce Sun could establish cyclical harmony within the cultivator’s body.

Anywhere between several thousand to tens of thousands of Seeds could result in this transformative physique.

“Marquis.”

“Greetings, Marquis.”

You Jue, Shi Song, and the other Qing Envoys immediately bowed toward Lord Qingfen.

“Greetings, Marquis.”

“The Yu Family greets Great Venerable Qingfen!”

Every member of the Yu Family, from elders to ordinary high-ranking clan members, bent low in reverence.

This was Lord Qingfen, the once fearsome and renowned Great Venerable Qingfen!

“Rise, all of you.”

Lord Qingfen motioned for them to stand before shifting his gaze back to Lin Yuan, speaking slowly, “Are you willing to join my Qingfen retinue?”

Having spoken, Lord Qingfen fell silent, patiently awaiting Lin Yuan’s response.

“So straightforward?”

Lin Yuan was momentarily taken aback. He had anticipated some standard pleasantries.

“I am willing.”

Lin Yuan promptly replied.

In the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, hierarchy was paramount. To secure greater resources and guidance, aligning oneself with a patron was essential.

And being recruited by Lord Qingfen, one of the conferred marquises of the ancient country, was the perfect starting point for Lin Yuan to integrate into the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

“Good. Prepare yourself. In half an hour, I will personally escort you back.”

With those words, Lord Qingfen disappeared.

“The Marquis is truly remarkable.”

“Indeed. Even faced with such monstrous talent, he remains composed.”

“Naturally. As a conferred lord of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, what kind of geniuses hasn’t he encountered?”

The tall figure of You Jue and the Qing Envoys exchanged glances, conversing in hushed tones. When they had first seen Yu Yan’s condensed ‘Sea of Fierce Sun,’ their hearts had overflowed with uncontrollable astonishment. Even Shi Song had struggled to articulate his thoughts to his senior.

Yet Lord Qingfen had maintained an unruffled demeanor throughout.

This composed behavior earned the Qing Envoys deep admiration.

…

Above the Yu Family.

Beneath the skies.

Lord Qingfen’s figure appeared, gazing down at the Yu Family.

Time passed.

Unable to restrain himself any longer, Lord Qingfen took a deep breath.

And—

“HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!”

“HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!”

“HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!”

Tumultuous azure flames churned in all directions, forming a sea of fire, though carefully contained within a fixed boundary. The flames roiled ceaselessly.

“Not yet stepped into the Self-Dao Realm, but has condensed ten thousand Seeds of the Fierce Sun and is already transforming into the Fierce Sun Divine Body?”

“And under five hundred years of age?!”

“Such talent! Such a monster! Born within my Qingfen Domain?!”

Lord Qingfen laughed endlessly, drunk with joy, his entire being immersed in incredulous elation.
